description: WellNet is a lightweight client-side mod  that keeps your game smooth in heavy modpacks. It monitors your session health and can automatically adjust settings like render distance to prevent sudden FPS drops and stuttering. The mod works purely on the client, so it can be used on almost any server without requiring server installation.

mods.name: WellNet
mods.description: Background stability helper for Minecraft that keeps heavy modpacks, local worlds, and online sessions feeling smoother by tracking connection quality, burst load, and client spikes in real time.

releases.notes:
WellNet 1.2.0 for Minecraft 1.20.4 on Fabric.

What's included:
- Separate jar for this exact Minecraft version and loader.
- Fixed render-distance config cap handling.
- Improved compatibility with Minecraft 1.19.2 and 1.20.4 client APIs.
- More stable integrated-host detection for local worlds.
- Clean release metadata for direct mod manager use.

Download the jar below that matches your Minecraft version and loader.
